title: PresentationMetadata
description: Deck-level metadata and rendering defaults for a presentation.

path.description: Output directory. Defaults to the current working directory.

company.description: Organization or company associated with the presentation.

date.description: Presentation date. Prefer ISO-8601 format when known.

description.description: Short description of the presentation purpose.

defaults.description: Rendering defaults inherited by slides and layouts unless overridden.

titleFontSize.description: Default title font size in points.

bodyFontSize.description: Default body font size in points.

smallFontSize.description: Default small/footer font size in points.

themeVersion.description: Identity of the corporate color theme (PresentationColorTheme) this deck was authored against, recorded so a separate migration tool can later decide whether the deck needs updating to a newer corporate theme. This library only records and round-trips this identity -- it does not resolve, store, or discover theme definitions.

id.description: Identifier of the corporate theme, e.g. a theme name or slug.

layoutVersion.description: Identity of the slide layout standard (PresentationSlideLayouts) this deck was authored against, recorded so a separate migration tool can later decide whether the deck needs updating to a newer layout standard. This library only records and round-trips this identity -- it does not resolve, store, or discover layout definitions.

id.description: Identifier of the layout standard, e.g. a layout-set name or slug.
